thread:
marta_s: Heads up — ZenithPay POC is showing lots of 429s during their load test and a few 503s. Customer ramp call at 14:00 PT. We need runtime + oncall to swarm. Details below. :rotating_light:
ajay_se: Can you paste an example curl + time window for the 429s? Also are they on Hosted or Dedicated?
marta_s: They're on hosted sandbox (trial account). Sample request:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-zenith' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","input":"Summarize this transaction...","max_tokens":300}'```Seeing ~50-70 concurrent threads during ramp, token usage ~120-300 per request. 429 body: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":0.8}` and occasional 503: `{"error":"no-ready-workers","code":503}`.
lucas_runtime: Thanks. Looking at our metrics now — prefix batching is getting saturated, and KV cache locks spike at concurrency ~40+. Do you have the route config (max_concurrency/burst)?
marta_s: Route is default: `max_concurrency: 20`, `burst: 10`, `policy: hosted-standard`. They pushed straight to the host endpoint for testing.
noah_oncall: Quick mitigations we can do before the call: 1) temporarily reduce client concurrency to 20, 2) enable fallback to a smaller model variant and 3) flip on burst-capacity if available. I'll try routing change now. @marta_s can you confirm customer is ok with fallback model?
vania_solutions: I can coordinate with the customer — they said short-term fallback is fine as long as latency improves. I'll message them now.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scaling group "hosted-sandbox-zenith" from 0 -> 2 gpus (requested by noah_oncall) :rocket:
ajay_se: If we route to a smaller model we should also reduce max_tokens to avoid long tail. Suggest policy update: `max_concurrency:10`, `fallback_model:"redwood-1-small"`, `max_tokens:180`.
noah_oncall: Executing policy update (one-liner):```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.run/api/v1/routes/update \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n -d '{"route":"zenith-gen","policy":{"max_concurrency":10,"fallback_model":"redwood-1-small","max_tokens":180}}'```
noah_oncall: Done — new policy applied. Watch for 429s for the next 5m.
lucas_runtime: I'm tailing runtime logs — before change: 429s ~ 120/min, 503s ~ 6/min; after change: 429s down to ~18/min, 503s to 0-1/min. Seeing fewer KV lock spikes. Keep an eye on latency.
marta_s: Customer on the call — they report prompt responses are looking better and fewer errors. Thanks. Pls keep channel open, they'll run another 10-min ramp at :45.
vania_solutions: Opening support ticket #SUP-8921 to track root cause and POC artifacts. I'll attach the replay and config.
shilpa_csm: Noted for SLA/credits conversation — save all request traces and token counts for the postmortem.
lucas_runtime: We'll capture full flame graphs and KV cache stats. Plan: roll hotfix to runtime to reduce KV lock window (v2.9.1) as a Canary, then full rollout if stable. ETA canary ~30m.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for runtime v2.9.1 to 10% of hosts (triggered by lucas_runtime).
lucas_runtime: Canary looks good so far — CPU and GPU utilizations stable, KV lock median down 45%. No regressions in latency.
noah_oncall: Monitoring; 429s holding at ~5/min during canary, 503s gone. If this holds for 30m, we'll promote.
marta_s: Customer happy for now, thanks team. Please post final status and a short incident summary once done.
lucas_runtime: Will dump artifacts to support ticket and drop a short RCA in #postmortems. Action items: 1) promote runtime v2.9.1 if canary holds, 2) adjust default route config for sandbox accounts (proposal to change default max_concurrency), 3) preserve traces for SLA review. ETA promoting in 30-40m.
vania_solutions: I'll coordinate the follow-up comms and scheduling for a deep-dive with the customer next week.
shilpa_csm: I'll handle any billing/credit asks, leave notes in the CRM.
marta_s: Great — closing the immediate ramp. Will update customer and keep thread open until promotion complete. :thumbsup:
